_description: MACHINE-WRITTEN ONLY. Do not hand-edit. Tracks Graphify freshness per repo. Written by _ops/skills/graph-refresh, read by the dashboard. nulls = not yet run.

_fields.graph_path: vault-relative path to the read-only Graphify output for this repo
_fields.last_graphify_run: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last `graphify update`, or null
_fields.repo_latest_commit: 40-char git SHA of repo HEAD at last check, or null
_fields.stale: bool — true if repo_latest_commit advanced past the commit the graph was built from; null = unknown
